final: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count FROM film f LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), first_avg AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM actor_counts), above_first AS (SELECT ac.film_id, ac.actor_count, ac.actor_count - fa.avg_count AS excess_first FROM actor_counts ac CROSS JOIN first_avg fa WHERE fa.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND ac.actor_count > fa.avg_count), second_avg AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM above_first), remaining AS (SELECT af.actor_count, af.excess_first, af.actor_count - sa.avg_count AS excess_second FROM above_first af CROSS JOIN second_avg sa WHERE sa.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND af.actor_count > sa.avg_count) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actor_count), 0) AS sum_actor_counts, AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_avg, AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_avg FROM remaining
